description.content: Retrieve a paginated list of customers for the authenticated workspace.

query.description: A case-sensitive filter on the list based on the customer's `email` field. The value must be a string. Takes precedence over `externalId`.
A case-sensitive filter on the list based on the customer's `externalId` field. The value must be a string. Takes precedence over `search`.
A search query to filter customers by email, externalId, or name. If `email` or `externalId` is provided, this will be ignored.
A filter on the list based on the customer's `country` field.
A filter on the list based on the customer's `linkId` field (the referral link ID).
Whether to include expanded fields on the customer (`link`, `partner`, `discount`).
The field to sort the customers by. The default is `createdAt`.
The sort order. The default is `desc`.
If specified, the query only searches for results before this cursor. Mutually exclusive with `startingAfter`.
If specified, the query only searches for results after this cursor. Mutually exclusive with `endingBefore`.
The number of items per page.

response.name: The list of customers.
